notes: pivot is the sprite origin as fractions of the frame (x right, y down): [0.5, 1.0] = bottom centre for ground props, [0.5, 0.5] = centre for pickups, [0.5, 0.0] = top centre for hanging props.

coin.description: Gold coin spinning about its vertical axis; 12 frames over 180 degrees, loops.

gem.description: Floating soul gem, glowing teal/violet; 12 frames over a quarter turn, loops.
